The '''Happy Grove''' was a section of forest on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], home to [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa's]] tribe of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], was located in the Happy Grove.
